text:
BLOCKED — not attempted, and not attemptable from a development machine.

This bead requires submitting real jobs to two authenticated Slurm sites and capturing the evidence. That needs credentials and cluster access; nothing about it can be simulated locally, and the fixtures already in the repo are explicitly marked supportClaim: false for exactly that reason.

The repo's own record shows where the last attempt stopped: docs/acceptance/p5-site-scale.md:52-60 documents the Trillium probe dying at "Permission denied (keyboard-interactive,hostbased)" with the honest summary that "no Slurm command ran, no job was submitted, and no version, cluster, account, partition, or policy fact was learned".

What IS ready for whoever has access:
- The capability matrix format is specified in this bead: mark every capability verified / experimental / unsupported / untested, which is far more trustworthy than a blanket "supports Slurm".
- The threshold for a PRODUCTION-SUPPORT claim is two real sites. An earlier EXPERIMENTAL release is permitted provided every capability is explicitly marked.
- Related capture beads are P7.1 (disposable-controller harness), P6f.5a (sacct array fixture) and P6f.33a (squeue absence transcript). P7.1's Docker path also failed on this machine — the 26.05 build hung on the Docker socket _ping (p5-site-scale.md:42-48) — so a working Docker daemon would unblock the synthetic half independently of site access.

Nothing in the local codebase blocks this. Every other P8 bead is closed.
